text.description_html:
AHI FLORENCE, Clear Acrylic Florence Knob with Satin Brass Square Rose

The Florence Knob with Square Rosette is a beautiful, statement piece that is perfect for adding transitional flair to any door. This door knob is made from clear acrylic with a solid brass rose. The Explore Hardware Florence Knob will fit most pre-drilled doors. It will fit 1-3/8 inch thick doors to 1-3/4 inch thick doors with 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. The Clear Acrylic Florence Knob with Satin Brass Square Rose is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions. This stunning clear acrylic door knob is suitable for interior use.

Features of the Explore Hardware Florence Knob:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors).
  • Solid metal knob and trim rose.
  • Sold as complete set.
  • Easy to install.

Specifications of the Florence Modern Knobset with Square Rose:

  • Knob Material: Clear Acrylic
  • Rosette Material: Brass
  • Rosette Finish: Satin Brass
  • Knob Diameter: 2.19" (55.6mm)
  • Knob Thickness: .88" (22.2mm)
  • Knob Stem Diameter: 1.56" (39.7mm)
  • Knob Projection: 1.87" (47.6mm)
  • Rose Length: 2.36" (59.9mm) square
  • Rose Projection: 0.39" (10mm)
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Handing: non-handed
  • AHI Florence Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Available Functions:

  • Single Dummy: No door latch. Door knob on one side of the door. Visible surface mounting screws. Package Includes: 1 knob, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door knobs on both sides of the door. Visible surface mounting screws on interior and exterior. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, and mounting screws.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Visible mounting screws on interior. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Privacy pin on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Visible mounting screws on interior. Package Includes: 2 knobs, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Sold Individually
